sara_cs: quick sync after Ternion private cutover — need to capture remaining items for network / IAM / KMS / audit logs and surface any renewal risk items. Can ops/security confirm status? :wave:
mike_cloudops: infra update: VPC peering established. noticed missing route to analytics-subnet (10.12.4.0/22) — added at 16:42 UTC. packet loss nil on our probes. throughput within SLO.
dave_netops: firewall update: opened outbound 443 to metrics endpoints and allowed NTP to 169.254.169.123 per the agents. Filed CR-4821 for the change. scheduling deeper firewall review next Tue.
anita_sec: KMS note: current key policy lacks kms:Decrypt for the rotation-lambda role. Need to amend before we enable automated rotations. Suggested diff below.
anita_sec: ```diff
- \"Principal\": { \"AWS\": \"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service-account\" }
+ \"Principal\": { \"AWS\": [
+   \"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service-account\",
+   \"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rotation-lambda\"
+ ] }
```
mike_cloudops: ok i'll stage the minor patch to the key policy today during low traffic window — non-disruptive.
leo_eng: audit logs: CloudWatch log group subscription to SIEM is active but retention is 30d; customer requested 365d and export to S3 for compliance. Raised ticket SEC-715 to extend retention and configure export lifecycle.
sara_cs: please confirm the S3 export bucket is encrypted and the access policy is least-privilege before we tell the customer it's done.
mike_cloudops: bucket (redwood-exports/ternion) uses SSE-KMS with cmk-ternion. We'll need a cross-account grant for tenant-ops role (arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/tenant-ops). @anita_sec — any objections from compliance?
anita_sec: fine if we add GrantPrincipal for tenant-ops with condition aws:ViaAWSService. i'll produce exact policy snippet and CR.
dave_netops: quick Networking follow-up: NAT gateway in us-west-2 showed elevated egress due to analytics misrouting earlier today. reroute applied; estimated monthly delta +$120 if patterns persist.
sara_cs: flagging cost increase as a potential renewal risk; i'll include it in the health report and propose a cost review with the customer.
leo_eng: runbook gaps: missing CMK rekey steps after rotation and an ops checklist for key grants. i'll add a section with sample CLI snippets.
leo_eng: ```bash
# create new CMK and schedule old key for rotation
aws kms create-key --description \"ternion cmk rotation\"
# example: add alias and grant to tenant ops
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/ternion-cmk --target-key-id <id>
```
sara_cs: i'll draft a short post-cutover summary + outstanding action list and send to Ternion today. will ask them to confirm retention and cross-account access. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
